title: Mod HUD Trackers
description: Gauges a mod adds to the top bar, after the four KPIs (Content/ui/hud_trackers.json, needs the InjectUI permission). Each tracker shows a number the mod names - a key of its saved state, a country event variable, a lifetime counter or an invasion wave's count - with its own label, icon, format, colour bands and target band. Presentation only: the file is outside the multiplayer content hash, so peers with different trackers just see different HUDs.

trackers.description: At most three trackers; more are ignored. With several mods, the first three in load order show.

id.description: The tracker's id, unique in the file (shown when it has no label).

value.description: The number: mod_state.<key> (the mod's saved state), variable.<name> (a country event variable), lifetime.<counter> (a lifetime counter: personnel_lost, regiments_lost, ships_lost, aircraft_lost, civilians_affected, provinces_gained, provinces_lost, wars_won, wars_lost) or wave.<wave id>.remaining | remaining_stacks | spawned | spawned_stacks (an invasion wave of this mod).

country.description: Whose number a variable or a lifetime counter is, and whose state visible_when tests: viewer (the local player's country) or a country's ISO3 code.

label_key.description: The localization key of the caps label (the mod's own Content/localization rows).

tooltip_key.description: The localization key of the hover text that explains the tracker.

icon.description: A PNG or JPG inside the mod folder, shown before the value (at most 2048 px a side, 4 MB).

max.description: The gauge's right end. With a max above min the tracker draws a band gauge under its value; without one it shows the value only.

format.description: number writes the value, percent writes it with a percent sign, of_max writes value / max (needs max).

bands.description: Colour bands, rising: from each band's value up to the next one, the value and the gauge marker take its tone.

tone.description: A HUD tone; the theme decides its colour.

target.description: The shaded target band on the gauge.

visible_when.description: Conditions that must all hold for the tracker to show (on the tracker's country): has_flag, not_has_flag, flag_age_months_gt/lt, variable_gt/lt/eq, lifetime_gt/lt, date_after, date_before, wave_eliminated, wave_remaining_gt/lt. Empty = always shown.
